g.text: ADCIN1=0 / ADCIN2=7: minimum 5V, maximum 20V fixed SPR. ADCIN3=0 / ADCIN4=1: 0A operating request, 3A maximum request. Read ACTIVE_CONTRACT_PDO/RDO over I2C before raising charger input/load limits; the integrated PPHV switch is not a continuous current limiter.

g.desc: ADCIN1=0 / ADCIN2=7: minimum 5V, maximum 20V fixed SPR. ADCIN3=0 / ADCIN4=1: 0A operating request, 3A maximum request. Read ACTIVE_CONTRACT_PDO/RDO over I2C before raising charger input/load limits; the integrated PPHV switch is not a continuous current limiter.

g.text: AlwaysEnableSink closes the path in dead-battery startup before explicit PD configuration. Keep charger and high loads disabled; USB_AUX_5V startup plus controller/system draw must stay within USB pre-enumeration budget. USB SDP is limited to the codec 100mA descriptor before enumeration; define suspend separately.

g.text: DRAIN pads 15/30/40 form TI internal drain island: keep isolated from external nets; connect local pad copper only per package layout. Pin 39 and all GND pins connect to GND. RESERVED pins tie GND per datasheet.

g.desc: DRAIN pads 15/30/40 form TI internal drain island: keep isolated from external nets; connect local pad copper only per package layout. Pin 39 and all GND pins connect to GND. RESERVED pins tie GND per datasheet.

g.text: PPHV bulk: 47uF nominal (TI recommends 47–100uF; derating/effective capacitance and attach inrush are not qualified here). Verify VBUS droop and controller pin peak during dead-battery attach, weak 5V source, PD transitions, hot-plug and target surge tests. Keep TVS2200 at connector and minimize return inductance; its 28.35V worst table clamp exceeds TPS25730D 28V abs by 0.35V; no above-abs transient allowance is specified.
